name: Lemongrass
hook: Lemongrass dying every winter? Bring it in before 7°C.

steps.title: 6+ hours of full sun
steps.tip: In summer, put it on your sunniest balcony or windowsill. In winter, keep it in a bright spot indoors.

steps.title: Never let the pot dry out
steps.tip: Keep the soil evenly moist in warm weather, but never waterlogged. Water only a little in winter.

steps.title: Inside before nights hit 7°C
steps.tip: It grows best above 13°C. Bring the pot indoors before nights drop below 7°C, and keep it warmer than that.

steps.title: Liquid fertilizer in summer
steps.tip: Potted plants need feeding. Give liquid fertilizer every 2–3 weeks from spring to late summer.

steps.title: Harvest thick outer stems
steps.tip: Cut thick stems with swollen bases from the edge of the clump, as low as you can. Use the bottom 10 cm.

steps.title: Root a store-bought stalk
steps.tip: Fresh stalks from the store root in a glass of water in about 2 weeks. Or divide a clump in spring.

outro: Sun, steady water and a warm winter indoors: lemongrass for years.
